newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis says no worries on France Telecom sale.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis says no worries on France Telecom sale.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Tuesday the process of selling a stake in state-owned France Telecom had been delayed because of the French snap election and he had no other worries about the sale.
He said the sale process would start on June 6, a month later than the original date.

"We want to avoid any confusion between the campaign of information for the privatisation of France Telecom and...the campaign for general (parliamentary) elections," he said in a prerecorded interview with CNN television to be broadcast at 1800 GMT.
"That is the reason why I have decided to delay the start of the privatisation. It's not a problem, it's to avoid any confusion between the two campaigns," he said.

Asked if he was worried about market conditions for a sale, he said: "No. France Telecom is a very competitive firm in the telecoms market and we are confident about the performance of this firm for the coming years".
